BND000.name: check.ok
BND000.why: The checked book has no open goals.

BND101.name: proof.laws_import_missing
BND101.why: PROOF.bend sits beside LAWS.bend but did not import it.
BND101.next: Import ./LAWS.bend as a module, then recheck.

BND102.name: proof.unsafe_import
BND102.why: The proof import graph contains @unsafe, so the proof is outside Bend's trusted live theory.
BND102.next: Remove the unsafe dependency or prove the required lemma without it.

BND103.name: check.incomplete
BND103.why: One or more TODO or open law goals remain.
BND103.next: Inspect the first residual goal and select one proof move.

BND110.name: checker.error
BND110.why: The Bend checker rejected a term, type, quantity, rewrite, pattern, or proof obligation.
BND110.next: Use the reported expected/observed terms, then load only the proof move or Base name needed by that distinction.

BND120.name: host.stack
BND120.why: Host recursion or literal expansion exhausted the machine stack.
BND120.next: Reduce recursion depth or literal expansion before changing proof structure.

BND200.name: cli.usage
BND200.why: The requested CLI form or named graph root is invalid.
BND200.next: Correct the command or request a checked name.

BND300.name: build.failed
BND300.why: The external compiler or backend build failed after Bend checking.
BND300.next: Inspect the build lane; do not change proof theory.
